card.line: Dura was a plain in the province of Babylon where King Nebuchadnezzar set up a huge golden statue and commanded everyone to worship it.

moments.title: The golden statue is set up
moments.text: King Nebuchadnezzar made a golden statue sixty cubits high and six cubits wide. He set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

moments.title: The command to worship
moments.text: Officials from all the provinces gathered before the statue. A herald said that when the music sounded, everyone must fall down and worship it, or be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace. When the people heard the music, they worshiped the statue.
